# AgentJetson.ai

> Sovereign edge AI that turns live video into real-time detection and operational intelligence for public safety. Defense-grade. Human-governed. Sovereign.

Agent Jetson runs on NVIDIA Jetson-class hardware and hardened edge nodes so detection stays local, low-latency, and under agency control.
